case_name: Trimbak v. State of Madhya Pradesh

pages.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
Trimbak ... Appellant
versus
State of Madhya Pradesh ... Respondent
Coram: Mehr Chand Mahajan, C.J., B.K. Mukherjea, B. Jagannadhadas, JJ.
Judgment Dated: 14 January 1954

MAHAJAN, C.J.:
1. The appellant was convicted under Section 411 of the Indian Penal Code for dishonestly receiving or retaining stolen gold ornaments belonging to a burglarized temple in Madhya Pradesh.

3. Decision: When stolen property was recovered from an open field accessible to anyone and not exclusively in the possession or custody of the accused, dishonest possession under Section 411 IPC cannot be presumed. Conviction set aside.
